articles.summary: Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (H.R. 1), many adults on Medicaid will soon need to regularly show proof of working, volunteering, or attending school to keep their Medicaid coverage. These are known as work requirements, or “community engagement requirements,” and they will take effect January 1, 2027.
articles.title: What You Need to Know About Medicaid Work Requirements

articles.summary: Over two days at AHIP, three separate sessions converged on a consistent picture: H.R. 1 is landing on systems already under pressure. The January 1, 2027 deadline is real but implementation will be iterative for years, and the moment demands more from plans than any prior redetermination cycle.
articles.title: What Medicaid Leaders Think About H.R. 1: Themes Across Three AHIP Panels
